rationale: The recent failures clustered around broad tail-loss and EMA interventions, so this stays on the 0031/0004 recurrent-tail path but narrows the EMA rescue to the tensors most likely to survive export sensitivity: recurrent-tail blocks, carry/control tensors, embeddings, and bigram/output scalars. The hypothesis is that broad quant-aware EMA was over-smoothing early/mid layers, while a tail-focused EMA can still stabilize the final int8 roundtrip without paying that training-quality tax.
title: Selective Tail EMA Export Stabilization
